``` ::: ::: Confidence (●●● high, ●●○ medium, ●○○ low) reflects how far the data can support the status call: coverage, survey frequency, and known gaps. Each tile links to the full indicator page, with methods and limitations. ## How to read this report card - **Status** summarises recent condition in plain language. It is my independent judgement from the published data, not an official assessment. - **Trend** describes direction of change over the period shown. Sea temperature is a context indicator, so it has no "good" or "bad" direction. - **Confidence** is reported separately so a clear trend in patchy data is not mistaken for a certain one. ::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"} This is an independent personal project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NatureScot, the Scottish Government Marine Directorate, JNCC, RSPB, BTO, or SMRU. For official assessments see [Scotland's Marine Assessment 2020](https://marine.gov.scot/sma/). :::
